def solution(x):
    n = abs(x)
    if n == 0:
        return 0

    # Remove all factors of 2; odd divisors depend only on the odd part.
    while n % 2 == 0:
        n //= 2

    # Count divisors of the odd part.
    divs = 1
    p = 3
    while p * p <= n:
        if n % p == 0:
            e = 0
            while n % p == 0:
                n //= p
                e += 1
            divs *= (e + 1)
        p += 2
    if n > 1:
        divs *= 2

    # Exclude x itself when x is odd (since x is then an odd divisor).
    if abs(x) % 2 == 1:
        divs -= 1
    return divs
```
